      How to ride

      Tap to jump. Hold in the air to backflip. Let go to land flat on your board. Flick for a board trick: forward a kickflip, back a heelflip, down a shove-it, up the Moon Grab. Flick diagonally for an acrobatic one: ↗ a barrel roll, ↖ a butterfly twist, ↘ a corkscrew, ↙ a spacewalk. Land before a trick comes round and you bail. Swing from a glowing orb: hold as it lights up (or tap it, or let it catch you as you jump past: Grapple orbs, above), let go to fly.

      Space or click: jump, hold in the air to backflip · → ← ↓ ↑ or D A S W: kickflip, heelflip, shove-it, Moon Grab · E Q X Z: barrel roll, butterfly twist, corkscrew, spacewalk · F grab a glowing orb (again to let go) · C camera · Esc P pause

      A jump, hold to backflip · flick the left stick or press the d-pad: board tricks · the right stick (or the left one diagonally): acrobatic tricks · X grab a glowing orb · Y camera · ☰ pause · B back
